Source: KRONOS Parameter Guide (official Korg documentation), page 17-18
  URL: https://cdn.korg.com/us/support/download/files/74a6c3cb0399c4d733d5730cd4c4e7f8.pdf
       (filename: KRONOS_Param_Guide_E11.pdf)
  Fetched: 2026-08-02
  Section: "Program P0: Play" > "0-1a: Program Select" > "Program Bank Contents"

Excerpt (text-extracted from the PDF, page 17):

---

Bank [INT-A...F, GM, g(1...9), g(d), USER-A...G and AA...GG]

This is the Bank of the current Program. You can change the Bank either via
the on-screen menu, or by using the front-panel Bank buttons.

To select banks INT-A...G or USER-A...G, simply press and release the
corresponding BANK button.

To select banks USER-AA...GG, press and hold a pair of I and U BANK buttons
together. For example, to select bank USER-CC, press and hold the I-C
button, and then press the U-C button.

Banks GM, g(1...9), and g(d): General MIDI

The GM bank contains a full set of General MIDI 2 Programs, as well as
variation sub-banks g(1)-g(9) (GM2 variation programs), and bank g(d)
(drums). [...] You can edit GM Programs, but you must then save them to a
different Bank; the GM Programs themselves cannot be over-written.

Program Bank Contents

As shipped from the factory, the contents of the Program Banks are as
follows:

* Bank contents may differ depending on the KRONOS model.

Bank Type [HD-1, EXi]

This shows whether the current Bank contains HD-1 Programs or EXi Programs.
The two Program types can't be mixed in a single bank.
  HD-1: The Bank contains HD-1 Programs.
  EXi: The Bank contains EXi Programs.

Changing the Program Bank Types

Banks can contain either HD-1 Programs or EXi Programs, but not both. This
assignment can be set separately for each bank. To do so:
  1. Press the front-panel GLOBAL button to enter Global mode.
  2. Select the Basic tab.
  3. Press the page menu button, and select Set Program Bank Type.
  4. Change the Type for the desired banks. Leave all of the other banks
     set to "No Change." Setting a bank's type will erase all of the
     Program data in the bank - so make sure that you're not erasing any
     Programs you want to keep!
  5. Press the OK button. An "are you sure?" dialog appears.
  6. If you're certain of the change, press OK again. The selected banks
     will now be initialized to use the new Program types.

--- Factory bank contents table (verbatim) ---

Bank            | Contents                          | Bank Type
INT-A           | Featured EXi sounds                | Bank type can be set
INT-B           | Featured HD-1 sounds                to either HD-1 or EXi
INT-C           | SGX-2, EP-1, and "best of" other EXi
INT-D           | AL-1
INT-E           | AL-1 and CX-3
INT-F           | STR-1
GM (I-G)        | GM2 main Programs
GMg(1)...g(9)   | GM2 variation Programs
g(d)            | GM2 drum Programs
USER-A          | MS-20EX & PolysixEX                | Bank type can be set
USER-B          | MOD-7                                to either HD-1 or EXi
USER-C...F      | HD-1
USER-G          | Initialized HD-1 Programs
USER-AA...BB    | HD-1
USER-CC...EE    | Initialized EXi Programs *
USER-FF...GG    | Initialized HD-1 Programs *

---

Notes for this project's own use of this table:
- This is the FACTORY DEFAULT layout, and the same manual explicitly says
  bank type (HD-1/EXi) -- and by extension, real-world usage of a bank --
  is user-reconfigurable per bank via Global mode. A community document
  already saved in this folder (Synthify's "no free banks" process doc)
  independently confirms real long-used Kronos units routinely drift from
  this factory layout. Treat this table as a strong DEFAULT/fallback label
  set, never as guaranteed-true for an arbitrary real file.
- Confirms this project's existing (previously unconfirmed, given directly
  by the project owner rather than independently verified) PROGRAM_BANK_NAMES
  list in frontend/pane.js is at least directionally correct in structure
  (INT-A..G, USER-A..G, USER-AA..GG), though the exact enumeration here
  (e.g. where GM/g(1..9)/g(d) fit as distinct banks vs. sub-views) hasn't
  been reconciled field-by-field against that array yet -- a separate task,
  not done as part of this bank-type classification work.
- The AL-1/CX-3/STR-1/SGX-2/EP-1/MS-20EX/PolysixEX/MOD-7 engine names give
  a real, specific answer to "which engine" beyond this project's current
  Hd1/Exi binary classifyProgramBankType() -- not implemented yet (only the
  HD-1/EXi split is built), kept here as ground truth for that follow-up.
